name: Paris
description: The City of Light — iconic monuments, world-class museums, and the finest cafés in the world.

name: Nice
description: The jewel of the French Riviera, with its stunning Promenade des Anglais and vibrant markets.

name: Lyon
description: Gastronomy capital of France, known for its Renaissance Old Town and legendary bouchon restaurants.

name: Tokyo
description: A dazzling metropolis where ancient shrines stand beside neon-lit skyscrapers and world-leading technology.

name: Kyoto
description: Japan's cultural heart — thousands of temples, traditional geisha districts, and serene bamboo groves.

name: Osaka
description: Japan's kitchen — vibrant street food culture, electric nightlife, and the mighty Osaka Castle.

name: Rome
description: The Eternal City — ancient ruins, baroque fountains, and the living museum of Western civilization.

name: Venice
description: A floating masterpiece of canals, Gothic palaces, and Renaissance art unlike anywhere on earth.

name: Florence
description: The cradle of the Renaissance — Michelangelo's David, Botticelli's Venus, and Brunelleschi's Dome.

name: Dubai
description: The city of superlatives — tallest buildings, grandest malls, and a desert that stretches to the horizon.

name: Abu Dhabi
description: The UAE's cultured capital — stunning Sheikh Zayed Mosque, Ferrari World, and Louvre Abu Dhabi.

name: Santorini
description: Iconic blue-domed churches, caldera sunsets, and volcanic beaches on the most romantic island on earth.

name: Athens
description: The birthplace of democracy, philosophy, and the Olympic games. The Acropolis reigns supreme.

name: Bangkok
description: A sensory overload of golden temples, floating markets, sky-high rooftop bars, and legendary street food.

name: Chiang Mai
description: Northern Thailand's cultural gem — ancient temples, elephant sanctuaries, and vibrant night bazaars.
